note: Site lists only 'Ecuador Robusto' (5x50). '107' commemorates La Aurora's 107th anniversary (founded 1903; cigar launched 2010) - the line comes in three wrapper sub-lines (107 Ecuador, 107 Nicaragua, 107 USA). Mac photos are a generic variety-pack group shot plus one single-cigar photo whose specific vitola could not be confirmed (best guess: Gran Toro, based on the filename's '6' - flagged as unverified in the renamed file). Given the line's existence is well-photographed even without a clean per-vitola match, the additional vitolas below reflect the verified current lineup per Cigars International's product listings, cross-checked against other sources.

additional_vitolas.name: Gran Toro
additional_vitolas.notes: Possibly what the Mac's unconfirmed single-cigar photo depicts, based on filename shorthand - not independently confirmed.

sub_line_specific_not_added: Lancero (6.875x40) and Zeppelin (5.5x42) appear to be specific to the '107 Ecuador' sub-line only per older listings - not added as general-line entries since sub-line attribution isn't fully confirmed current. An older 2012 Cigar Coop review also references a 'Corona' (5.5x43) and 'Gran 107' (7x58) not found in current retailer listings - likely discontinued, not added.
